title: Amazon PPC Executive
description:
Amazon PPC Executive

Location: Milton Keynes

Our client is looking for an Amazon PPC Executive to join their team on a full time permeant basis. As an Amazon PPC Executive, you will be at the forefront of managing and optimising Amazon advertising campaigns to drive traffic and sales. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, analytical skills, and strong communication abilities. You will play a pivotal role in the company's marketing efforts, ensuring that advertising campaigns are performing optimally and contributing to the business's success.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
- Conduct keyword research to identify relevant and high-traffic keywords for ad campaigns.
- Create and launch PPC campaigns on Amazon using tools such as Amazon Advertising Console.
- Write compelling ad copy that accurately represents the product and entices customers to click.
- Monitor and adjust bids to ensure optimal campaign performance while staying within budget.
- Analyse campaign data and make adjustments to improve performance, such as targeting and ad placement.
- Produce reports that clearly communicate campaign results and insights to the team.
- Conduct A/B tests to determine the most effective ad copy, keywords, and targeting strategies.
- Manage advertising budgets to align spending with business goals and objectives.
- Analyse competitor advertising campaigns to identify opportunities and threats.
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and changes to Amazon's advertising platform.

Skills and Experience:
- Proven expertise in PPC advertising principles and best practices.
- Strong analytical skills to analyse campaign performance data and produce insightful reports.
- Knowledge of keyword research tools and techniques.
- Ability to write compelling and effective ad copy.
- Experience managing bid strategies and budgets for optimal campaign performance.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across various teams.
- Attention to detail to ensure campaigns are set up and managed correctly.
- A willingness to stay current with industry trends and changes.

Company Benefits:
- Casual dress
- On-site parking
- Regular social events including summer and end-of-year parties
- Spontaneous employee well-being treats
- Vouchers at Christmas to shop with the company
- Private medical insurance
- Gym membership discounts

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist

Location: Tongwell, Milton Keynes (Hybrid - 3 days office, 2 days home)
Contract: 12-month assignment
Pay Rate: £19.23 per hour
Hours: 35 per week Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00

Are you a creative and data-driven digital marketer ready to make an impact? We're looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist to help shape and deliver high-profile national media campaigns that support key business areas - from exciting product launches to premium vehicle promotions.

This is your chance to work with a globally recognised automotive brand, collaborating with top-tier creative and media agencies, and driving campaigns that reach millions.

What You'll Be Doing

Campaign Development & Execution: Support the Digital Brand Marketing Manager in delivering multi-channel campaigns across digital, social, outdoor, experiential, and broadcast platforms.
Creative Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams and external partners to bring bold ideas to life and ensure brand consistency.
Media Planning & Innovation: Maximise campaign impact through smart media planning and by integrating emerging media opportunities.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with product, sales, and PR teams to ensure marketing strategies align with business goals.
Data-Driven Optimisation: Use analytics to refine campaigns, improve performance, and generate high-quality leads.
Performance Reporting: Present campaign results and ROI insights to senior stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

Proven experience in marketing, preferably within the luxury automotive or premium consumer goods industry.
Demonstrated success in delivering high-impact marketing campaigns and product launches.
Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including VOD, social media, and experiential marketing.
Clear understanding of the marketing funnel and how to align campaign strategies with customer journeys.
Experience working with creative and media agencies.
Strong analytical skills and a passion for campaign performance.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
A proactive mindset and a collaborative approach.

Why Apply?

This is more than just a marketing role, it's an opportunity to be part of a team that's shaping the future of automotive marketing. You'll gain exposure to high-impact campaigns, work with industry-leading partners, and contribute to a brand that's synonymous with innovation and excellence.

Ready to accelerate your marketing career? Apply now and help drive campaigns that make a difference.

Hays Talent Solutions is a trading division of Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited and acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: EMEA Senior Brand Manager Growth Platforms (M/F)
description:
EMEA Senior Brand Manager Growth Platforms (M/F)

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

Reporting into the EMEA Growth Platforms HSS Marketing Manager, you will work as regional SBM supporting the Herbs, Spices and Seasonings strategy across our EMEA business; leading and delivering strategic projects based on our 3 year product pipeline across both renovation and innovation. Working closely with the Local Marketing teams and cross-functional teams including Commercialisation, Insights, Graphics Design, R&D, Supply Chain and Culinary, as well as external agencies when needed, to deliver scalable, winning plans to drive McCormick Sales, Share & profitability.

Insights & Analytics:
- Leveraging ongoing business analytics to monitor Category & NPD performance across the EMEA region
- Ongoing consumer trends & research, you will be the consumer insights expert for your dedicated focus areas
- Working closely with our Insights & Analytics team you will turn datapoints and research into insights and insights into actions, to identify category innovation and renovation opportunities across the EMEA region
- Drive NPD & renovation post evaluations with actionable insights & build learnings into future plans
- Sharing best practices in EMEA region and Global Ecosystem
- Build and deliver regular business presentations to key stakeholders and senior leaders across local markets, the regional and global teams.

Strategy & Plans:
- Support the Development of the 3 year strategy for Herbs, Spices and Seasonings, using this to shape the product pipeline & activation plan for your areas & input into the annual EMEA regional brand plans
- Lead the development & delivery of innovation and renovation through all stage Gates, gaining continued stakeholder alignment as you do so, whilst working with key functions from ideation through to execution & Go to Market
- Input into the preparation of Quarterly Global Innovation Updates to Senior Leadership teams
- Support our sustainability roadmap to deliver against our goals
- Act as a regional member for your portfolio, liaising with wider global teams where relevant

Commercial:
- Accountable for the delivery of agreed innovation targets with P&L responsibility
- Contribute to the product life cycle management, driving efficiencies through simplification
- Partner closely with category management, sales and omnichannel representatives across markets to define optimum channel strategies

Team and personal leadership:
- Act as a member of a team of 3 and collaborate based on the priorities set up by the MM
- Manage workload and priorities balancing priorities if needed in collaboration with the MM
- Balance short term priorities with longer term deliverables
- Demonstrate active listening and collaboration with key stakeholders across the business and ultimately determining the right action plans; influencing teams where needed to bring them on board with the priorities and plans

CANDIDATE PROFILE
- Proven track record: successful experience working within FMCG Innovation & Brand-Building at the relevant level
- Curious, data-driven & analytical: you will excel working with the likes of Nielsen, Kantar, Google Trends and Ad hoc research to perform analysis & turn insights into actions
- Full mix marketing: Ideally someone with experience beyond Innovation and Renovation; meaning they are able to understand the overall picture and influence of the various marketing levers and the role I&R can play within this
- Consumer-Centric: you will naturally place the consumer at the heart of everything you do & will excel at driving insight from market research & trends data, be comfortable working with a variety of research methodologies and a multitude of agencies
- Expertise in NPD and renovation: Excellence in NPD development, execution & portfolio management, influencing and collaborating to drive what's needed to grow against a clear category vision
- A sense of ownership: you'll see your area as your own business & love to roll up your sleeves & get stuck into building & leading your platform & brands growth
- Prioritisation: Strong project leadership experience of managing multiple projects & strong ability to prioritise when and where needed
- Cross-Functional team player: building strong relationships across departments within EMEA, you'll naturally take everyone with you & work as one team to deliver against one common goal
- Positive, can-do spirit: you'll bring bags of energy & enthusiasm to driving your platform growth
- Entrepreneurial mindset & ability to challenge the status quo: acting like an owner you will identify new challenges and tackle them in innovative and lateral ways, striving to push boundaries and build transformational thinking on your portfolio
- Passion for food: ideally someone who is a "foodie" and always looking for their next inspiration

Eligible roles may participate in one of McCormick's Bonus Plans. In addition to a competitive compensation package, McCormick employees are eligible for our comprehensive Total Rewards programs, which include, but are not limited to:
- annual bonus
- health cash plan
- private medical insurance
- pension
- group income protection - on completion of 2- year service;
- employee referral program
- employee assistance program

McCormick ensures compensation is determined in line with the principle of equal pay for work of equal value, regardless of gender.

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Junior Content Marketing Executive
company: Cameo Consultancy Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are looking for a creative and versatile part-time Junior Content Marketing Executive to join a highly successful business based in Buckingham, with decades of experience in the commercial vehicle testing equipment sector. The role is based on site on a part time basis between 24 and 32 hours a week with a salary of up to £28,000.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop your content marketing skills while helping to strengthen our brand awareness and support marketing campaigns across multiple channels. Working closely with their European head office and central marketing team, you'll use your creative talent to produce engaging content, contribute ideas and support a variety of marketing projects and activities.

Key Responsibilities for the Junior Content Marketing Executive:
- Creating, editing and publishing engaging marketing content in line with the brand
- Working closely with the European head office to support marketing campaigns and activities
- Developing content for websites, blogs, social media, email campaigns and other marketing materials
- Supporting the planning and delivery of content calendars and integrated marketing campaigns
- Creating and optimising photo, video and other digital content
- Assisting with SEO activities and website content optimisation
- Monitoring content performance and identifying opportunities to improve engagement
- Researching industry trends and competitor activity to support new content ideas
- Organising and maintaining digital assets and marketing materials
- Communicating regularly with head office and collaborating with colleagues across the business

Key Skills and Experience Required for the Junior Content Marketing Executive:
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for creating engaging content
- Basic knowledge of content marketing, social media and digital marketing channels
- Experience using content creation tools for graphics, video and social media
- Knowledge of graphic design and desktop publishing would be an advantage
- Experience creating, editing and publishing photo and video content
- An interest in SEO, digital campaigns and content performance
- Strong attention to detail and an eye for consistent branding, colour and imagery
- A creative, proactive and enthusiastic approach, with a willingness to learn
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
- A collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently and with different teams
- An interest in AI and digital tools that can improve content creation and productivity
- A UK driving licence

What's in it for you?
- Part-time hours of 24 - 32 per week
- Salary of up to £26,000 to £28,000
- 22 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing with service
- Training, support and opportunities for personal development and career progression
- The opportunity to work for a successful, established international business
- Private healthcare for you and your family after successful completion of a six-month probation period

title: Marketing and Content Coordinator
description:
Marketing and Content Coordinator

Location: Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire

Salary: 26,000 - 28,000 Pro Rata (2 days per week)

Working arrangement: Based in Milton Keynes, with travel to live events and occasional evening or weekend work

MFK Recruitment is recruiting a Marketing and Content Coordinator to join a well-established and creative business specialising in live events, event production and experiential projects.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, organised and commercially minded marketing professional who enjoys producing engaging content, developing marketing campaigns and seeing their work come to life.

Our client delivers a variety of live events and creative projects, working with talented teams across production, design and technical disciplines.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the company's day-to-day marketing activity, capturing content from live events, developing its digital presence and supporting business growth through targeted marketing campaigns.

This position would suit someone who enjoys a varied role, has a strong eye for content and is equally comfortable creating social media posts, visiting events with a camera and researching new business opportunities.

The Role

Working closely with the Managing Director and wider team, you will be responsible for planning, creating and delivering marketing content across multiple channels.

You will have the opportunity to get behind the scenes of live events, capture the work being delivered and turn it into engaging content that showcases the company's creativity, expertise and capabilities.

Alongside content creation, you will help identify new markets, develop targeted campaigns and support the company's ongoing commercial growth.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing and Content Creation
- Plan, manage and maintain the company's marketing and content calendar.
- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email campaigns and other digital platforms.
- Write and edit compelling copy for marketing materials, advertising, case studies and promotional campaigns.
- Design graphics and social media assets using Canva, Adobe or similar creative software.
- Attend live events, rehearsals, production builds and other activities to gather behind-the-scenes content.

Digital Marketing and Campaigns
- Manage social media content, including planning, scheduling, publishing and engagement.
- Keep website content accurate, relevant and optimised for search engines.
- Develop and coordinate targeted email marketing and digital campaigns.
- Monitor social media performance, website traffic and campaign engagement.

Collaboration and Event Content
- Work closely with production, projects, design and operational teams to identify marketing opportunities.
- Attend events and project locations to capture authentic content.
- Coordinate photography, filming and interviews with colleagues, clients and venues.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in marketing, content creation, digital marketing or communications.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong copywriting and proofreading abilities.
- Experience creating engaging content for social media and digital platforms.
- Practical experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design software.
- A full UK driving licence and valid passport.
- Willingness to travel and occasionally work evenings or weekends when events require it.

Desirable Experience
- Previous marketing experience within live events, event production, creative agencies or a B2 B environment.
- Experience producing marketing content at live events.
- Knowledge of website content management and SEO best practices.
- Experience developing email marketing campaigns.
- Familiarity with CRM systems and supporting new business development activity.
- Experience producing case studies, client presentations or promotional materials.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys marketing and content creation, rather than simply managing social media accounts.

You will be naturally curious, confident in communicating with different teams and comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial ideas through to delivery.

The ideal candidate will be creative enough to spot a great content opportunity, organised enough to deliver it on time and commercially aware enough to understand how marketing contributes to business growth.

An interest in live events, production, design or the wider creative industries would be particularly beneficial.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join an established business operating within the live events and creative production industry.
- Direct involvement in shaping the company's marketing activities and digital presence.
- Close collaboration with senior management and creative production teams.
- Opportunities to develop your experience across marketing strategy, content production and business development.

title: Marketing Co-ordinator - Live Event Production
description:
You'll take responsibility for delivering engaging, consistent and effective marketing across the business, working closely with the Managing Director and colleagues across Production, Projects, Warehouse, Set and Scenic, and new business.

Your role will combine content creation, campaign management, market research and lead generation, giving you the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the business's growth.

Brand Marketing
- Plan and manage the marketing and content calendar, aligning activity with business priorities and growth objectives.
- Create, write, edit and publish engaging content across social media, websites, email campaigns and advertising.
- Develop case studies, project highlights, award submissions, sales collateral and other materials.
- Create eye-catching graphics and social media assets using Canva, Adobe etc
- Capture and edit photography and short-form video to bring projects to life.

Social Media and Digital Marketing
- Plan, schedule and publish content across relevant social media platforms.
- Monitor engagement, respond appropriately to comments and messages, and identify opportunities to grow our online presence.
- Track website, social media, email and campaign performance using relevant analytics tools.

Business Development
- Research markets, competitors, industry trends and customer needs to identify opportunities for growth.
- Identify new audiences, potential clients and priority sectors to support business development.
- Build and maintain accurate prospect lists using appropriate, data protection-compliant methods.

Business Support
- Work closely with teams across the business to identify upcoming projects, gather information and maximise content opportunities.
- Build strong relationships with colleagues, clients, venues and suppliers to support content capture and marketing activity.
- Coordinate marketing suppliers, print, promotional materials and agreed budgets, obtaining approval before committing expenditure.

You'll ideally bring:
- Experience in marketing within live events, creative services or a B2 B environment.
- Strong UK English copywriting and proofreading abilities
- Practical experience using Canva, Adobe or similar tools to create marketing assets.
- The ability to capture and edit photography and short-form video.
- Familiarity with social media platforms, content scheduling tools and digital analytics.
- An understanding of campaign planning, market research and audience targeting.
- Experience with CRM systems, prospect research and lead generation
- A valid UK driving licence and passport, with flexibility to travel and occasionally work evenings or weekends to support live events.

Prospero Teaching is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Our Buckinghamshire based client is seeking a motivated Marketing Coordinator to join their growing team. The successful candidate will help deliver multichannel marketing campaigns that combine scientific accuracy, creative communication and audience insight to support healthcare professionals lifelong learning.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career marketing professional with one to two years experience and an interest in healthcare, life sciences or education. The ideal candidate will have strong copywriting and organisational skills, experience with organic social media and a data-driven approach to campaign performance. Marketo and paid social experience would be advantageous.

This is a Hybrid role based close to Marlow. working two days per week in the office

Key Responsibilities for the Marketing Coordinator role are:
- Coordinate marketing campaigns targeting healthcare professionals, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to brand standards.
- Write engaging copy for email, social media, newsletters and press materials.
- Deliver email campaigns through Marketo, including segmentation, testing and reporting.
- Manage and optimise organic and paid social media activity.
- Collaborate with internal teams, clients, designers and external suppliers.
- Support database growth, data quality and campaign research.
- Monitor performance and use insights to improve campaign effectiveness.

Skills Required for the Marketing Coordinator role are:
- Degree educated with one to two years marketing experience.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience with organic social media campaigns; paid social experience is desirable.
- Good analytical skills and confidence interpreting campaign performance data.
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and time management.
- An interest in healthcare, life sciences or medical education.
- Marketo experience is advantageous but not essential.

Benefits
- 25 days annual leave plus three additional days over Christmas.
- Pension contributions.
- Private Medical Insurance following probation.
- Hybrid working arrangements.

If you would like to find our more apply today

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Marketing & Proposals Coordinator - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract

Milton Keynes

Competitive salary, negotiable depending on your experience and expertise.

Are you ready to bring your marketing coordination, and communication skills to a role where your organisation, attention to detail, and ideas can make a lasting impact?

What Sets Us Apart

At MHA, we're about people first - our people, our clients, and the communities we serve. As one of the UK's top 11 accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the 8th largest network in the world, we are a hub of global knowledge with a strong local commitment.

Our people-focused approach truly sets us apart. Here, you won't just be another face in the firm; you'll be part of an ambitious, driven team dedicated to continuous learning and growth. We invest in our people because they are the foundation of our success. With access to unparalleled resources and award-winning development programmes, you'll have the freedom to shape your career while making a meaningful impact. We take immense pride in being awarded gold for Investors in People. This recognition reflects our deep commitment to nurturing talent and ensuring every individual feels valued and supported.

Here, You'll Shape More Than Careers

We're looking for a talented Proposals Coordinator from a marketing background who thrives in a people-focused environment and sees challenges as opportunities for growth. At MHA, you'll work alongside passionate professionals who care about making a difference.

If you are used to working in a busy environment, and to tight deadlines, this is the role for you

What We Are Looking For
- Essential to be experienced in using PowerPoint at an advanced level.
- Essential to be experienced at using Adobe InDesign
- High level use and understanding of the English language, spelling / grammar / comprehension.
- Excellent communications skills
- Able to work under own steam but very much as part of a team, in a busy environment with tight deadlines.
- Experience with working with professional services firms and / or working with pitch teams an advantage but not essential.

Your duties & responsibilities
- Primarily to work with the proposals team on the creation and design of the proposals they are working on, these are usually created using a mixture of PowerPoint, and at times Adobe InDesign.
- Secondly, to work with the national marketing team, supporting them with all their requirements surrounding digital brochures, insights, adverts, marketing campaigns, as well as printed brochures, pull up banners, event materials etc.
- Work with the team and partners to create PowerPoint presentations.
- Have high levels of attention to detail.
- Be able to work within strict brand guidelines.
- Have an excellent command of the English language, spelling, and grammar.
- Work with our other highly experienced graphic designer and the proposals team against briefs.
- There are also opportunities for you to support the marketing team in other general marketing activities including events.
- Manage and maintain PowerPoint templates within Templafy, ensuring brand consistency through the upload and administration of approved images and icons, and generate reporting on template usage and performance.

Rewards That Resonate

You're more than a number to us; you're an individual with unique talents and aspirations. Our benefits are designed to support your well-being, foster your professional growth, and recognise your contributions.

Agile Working: Enjoy the flexibility of core hours from 10 AM to 2 PM and two home working days, allowing you to balance your work and personal commitments seamlessly.

33 days holiday Inc. bank holidays, plus the opportunity to buy or sell up to 5 days (28 days on a training contract, with the opportunity to buy 5 days)

Competitive salary package

Employee recognition awards: Outstanding Performance Award Bonus, and other recognition initiatives.

New and improved programme for succession planning and supportive management structure to help you realise your potential

Employee Assistance Programme: Access a free confidential 24-hour support service, including unlimited counselling sessions and virtual doctors available for you and your family.

And lots more!

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Are you a marketing professional who enjoys delivering creative campaigns that make a measurable commercial impact?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, balancing multiple projects while building strong relationships with stakeholders across different locations?

Are you passionate about using a mix of marketing channels to increase customer engagement, strengthen brand visibility, and drive business performance?

If you can answer yes to the above questions, then this could be the PERFECT role for you!

Reed Marketing & Creative are currently working with a well-established and highly successful multi-site consumer business that is looking to recruit an experienced Marketing Executive to join its growing marketing team.

Please note this is a fixed term contract for 12 months

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement targeted marketing activity across a variety of offline and customer engagement channels to support venue performance and brand awareness.
- Partner with venue and regional leadership teams to understand local market opportunities and identify marketing solutions that deliver commercial results.
- Coordinate the creation, production, and deployment of marketing collateral to support promotions, events, and customer engagement initiatives.
- Act as a key marketing contact for operational stakeholders, offering guidance, recommendations, and best-practice support.
- Work closely with creative, operational, and agency partners to ensure campaigns are executed consistently and effectively.
- Monitor the effectiveness of marketing initiatives through reporting and evaluation, identifying opportunities to optimise future activity.
- Manage designated campaign budgets, ensuring expenditure is controlled and marketing investment delivers maximum value.
- Contribute to broader marketing projects and business initiatives, supporting the achievement of company-wide growth objectives.

The Successful Candidate Will:
- Have previous experience within a marketing, campaign, or communications role, ideally supporting multiple locations or business units.
- Possess strong knowledge of traditional marketing channels such as print, direct mail, outdoor advertising, events, and local promotions.
- Demonstrate experience planning, coordinating, and delivering integrated marketing campaigns from concept through to evaluation.
- Have excellent stakeholder management skills and the confidence to build effective relationships across all levels of a business.
- Take a proactive and solutions-focused approach to work, demonstrating initiative and a positive attitude.
- Be comfortable analysing campaign results and using insights to improve future performance.
- Hold a full driving licence and be willing to travel regularly across the region as required.

In Return You Will Receive:

A competitive salary of 30,000 - 35,000 DOE, hybrid working, performance-related bonus opportunities, company laptop and mobile phone, and the opportunity to join a dynamic business where you can make a genuine impact on marketing performance across a diverse portfolio of locations. Regular regional travel with occasional overnight stays

If you are keen to know more about this fantastic opportunity as a Marketing Executive, please click on the link to apply! Alternatively, you can get in touch with Bianca Halliburton at Reed Marketing & Creative in Reading.
